From: Samira Khan <samira@streamlinehr.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: In-person evaluation request + logistics questions

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at Streamline HR would like to bring 6 people to Redwood for an in-person evaluation and a short hands-on session. We’re targeting the week of August 17; our preferred windows are the morning of Tue 8/18 or afternoon of Wed 8/19.

Quick questions so we can align on travel and approvals: 
- Do you have a preferred conference room that seats 8 with video conferencing (Zoom + HDMI) and a whiteboard?
- We’ll need an NDA in place prior to the visit. Can you send your standard partner NDA or a DocuSign link?
- Will there be an on-site point of contact for visitor badging and a 15-minute safety briefing?
- Any laptop/AV constraints we should know about (USB-C only, adapters available)?

Attachments: none on this email — will provide headcount after you confirm windows.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Director, Product Evaluation
Streamline HR
samira@streamlinehr.com

- AV: We provide USB-C -> HDMI adapters and a spare MacBook for demos, but if you bring specialized hardware let us know and we’ll test connectivity in advance.
